text:
Priya Rao: Kickoff: Northshore wants a regional pilot in Halifax (Nova Scotia colo). Scope: 3 reserved A100-equivalent nodes, cross-account AWS KMS, marketplace tile, and a short pilot announcement. Target soft-launch: 2025-02-12. Who owns quotas / billing / legal?

Ethan Brooks: I can take cloud quota + provisioning. Need exact SKU and expected qps/tokens. ETA to open request: today.

Northshore - Carlos: Baseline ~10k req/day, burst to 40k. Avg 200 tokens/request, spikes to 800. Suggested SKUs: a100e-48g (x3) + 1 burst node. AWS region: ca-central-1.

Maya Singh: Marketplace lead  Ill draft the tile. Drop logos (SVG + PNG) and a one-paragraph blurb. Prefer partner-provided compliance statements (SOC2, KMS HSM).

Priya Rao: Security note: cross-account CMK is OK but we need grant policy + key ARN. Add requirement: VPC peering and VPC flow logs.

Northshore - Carlos: We can provide SOC2 Type II and HSM-backed KMS. Rotation policy quarterly. Will upload assets and compliance docs by 2024-12-20.

billing-bot: Reminder: to enable reserved pricing on marketplace we need a purchase order or contract reference before provision. See https://go/redwood/partners/po-steps

Ethan Brooks: Opening quota ticket now: CREQ-NS-5566. Request: 3x a100e-48g reserved + 1 burst. Start date requested: 2025-01-10, duration 6 months. Link: https://console.cloud.example/CREQ-NS-5566

Maya Singh: Draft marketplace copy (v0): "Northshore + Redwood pilot: low-latency Halifax edge for enterprise LLMs. Dedicated GPUs, customer-managed keys, and private peering." Feedback?

Priya Rao: Good. Add a short line: "Available to select customers during pilot; enterprise onboarding supported." Also add a short compliance bullet for KMS and SOC2.

legal-ops: Will need a one-paragraph co-announcement and approval flow. Also draft a simple DPA addendum for the listing. Allow 3 business days after we receive the draft.

Ethan Brooks: CREQ-NS-5566 submitted. Est approval 5-8 business days. Ill post updates here.

Northshore - Carlos: Assets + compliance bundle scheduled for upload 2024-12-18. Contact for DPA: legal@nshore.example.com

Priya Rao: Action items recap: Ethan -> monitor CREQ-NS-5566 and provision; Maya -> finalize marketplace tile after assets; Legal -> DPA + PR guardrails; Security -> confirm KMS grant template. Next sync Thurs 14:00 UTC. :calendar:

Ethan Brooks: Flag: if quota delays, fallback is Hosted small nodes for initial pilot (no marketplace). Ill own fallback provisioning.

Maya Singh: Noted, marketing will prep a "pilot waitlist" landing page if needed.

Priya Rao: Thanks all. Please drop ticket links and uploads into this thread.
